biomarkers.name: KRAS G12R
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Tissue or plasma NGS confirming KRAS G12R; required for G12R-specific or pan-KRAS-G12X inhibitor eligibility.

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Tissue NGS variant call with predicted loss-of-function or known hotspot; informs co-mutation context, not a direct therapy gate.

biomarkers.name: CDKN2A
biomarkers.decision_resolution: NGS copy-number call or IHC p16 loss; relevant for CDK4/6 inhibitor rationale.

biomarkers.name: CCND3
biomarkers.decision_resolution: NGS-detected amplification or activating alteration; relevant for cyclin/CDK-axis targeting rationale.

biomarkers.name: MSI status
biomarkers.decision_resolution: MSI-high required for tumor-agnostic ICI (pembrolizumab); MSS effectively excludes that pathway.

biomarkers.name: TMB
biomarkers.decision_resolution: TMB ≥10 mut/Mb required for tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab; 4.1 mut/Mb does not meet that threshold.

targetable_features.rationale: Emerging G12X-pan and G12R-selective small-molecule inhibitors (e.g. RMC-6236 divarasib-class, dedicated G12R programs); historically the most actionable allele in PDAC after G12C and G12D.
Co-mutation marker — modifies expected response to DDR-directed and cell-cycle-directed approaches; some early-phase trials enrich for or stratify by TP53 status.
Loss of p16 derepresses CDK4/6 — provides mechanistic rationale for CDK4/6 inhibitors (palbociclib, ribociclib, abemaciclib) alone or in KRAS-inhibitor combinations.
Cyclin D3 amplification/activation drives CDK4/6 dependency; reinforces CDK4/6 inhibitor rationale and may support cyclin-D-degrader programs.
Decision-relevant negative finding — excludes tumor-agnostic ICI on the MSI-H label and flags single-agent PD-1/PD-L1 as low-yield; pushes immunotherapy thinking toward combinations or trial-only.
Below the 10 mut/Mb tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab threshold; reinforces low expected ICI monotherapy benefit and the need to look at non-ICI strategies first.
